headline: The hideout breathes: light moves, shadows lean, the yard lives
lede: Slot b shipped DOUBLE DRAGON's yard cast law (#2877) — the never-dry pick that scored the game weakest on the shelf. S3's swinging chain-lamps are now the stage's key light: light pools slide across the concrete with their shades, and every shadow on the floor leans against the lamp overhead. The street stays still on purpose — its sodium fittings are dead fixtures, so each stage keeps its own light.

notes.text: Grounded at last: fighters, goons, Marian, crates, drums and spilled steel all carry a floor shadow that lifts and shrinks with the hop and drifts with the lamp. Set dressing: 28 seeded swarf chipplings by the oil seeps, and a drum that leaks on a 72-tick beat — with one quiet drip blip while it's on screen.

ddragoncheck 138/138 with two new pixel legs on the real canvas, and three new named mutants (same-phase, street-on, shimmer) — 15/15 die with the harm spelled out. The session also finished the previous lane's #2852 step-8: prod verified, building->shipped, live URL posted.

Rule 4 keeps turning: seven game-code PRs in a row across the two slots (#2850, #2853, #2855, #2856, #2862, #2872, #2879). PLAICRAFT S2 (#1712) closed on the research side; the other slot is inside CONTRA #2880.
